name: Eliakim
overview: The name Eliakim appears in Scripture referring to several individuals, including a priest listed among those with trumpets (Nehemiah 12:41) and a descendant in the genealogy of Christ (Matthew 1:13). Notably, Eliakim, son of Hilkiah, served as the chief steward or deputy over King Hezekiah's household, playing a key role in communicating during the Assyrian threat (Isaiah 36:3, 36:11, 36:22, 37:2). This Eliakim’s leadership under Hezekiah highlights God’s providential governance through faithful servants in times of crisis.
